title.en: 2026 Clash Verge Rev Complete Setup Guide: From GitHub Releases Download to Subscription Import

description.zh: 面向 Windows / macOS / Linux 用户的 2026 最新版 Clash Verge Rev 官方保姆级安装与订阅配置教程。详解 GitHub Releases 安装包选型、订阅链接加密导入、智能规则分流模式切换与常见系统代理失效排查。
description.en: The definitive 2026 setup handbook for Clash Verge Rev on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Step-by-step guidance on release artifact selection, encrypted subscription import, rule-based proxy routing, and system proxy failover.
